subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for the linked `message_sending` bypass once the suffix re-entry bug is repaired, including the internal `runsMessageSendingAtDelivery` ownership contract?
rationale: The patch changes a pre-send safety-hook boundary shared by plugins and channels, and multiple open PRs cover narrower slices of the same issue, so maintainer intent is needed after the concrete P1 defect is fixed.

options.title: Repair and continue this PR
options.body: Fix suffix re-entry, keep the dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final coverage together, and use this as the canonical branch for the linked issue.

options.title: Split to a narrower dispatcher fix
options.body: Land a smaller dispatcher-only branch and leave Telegram streamed-final enforcement to a follow-up, accepting that the linked issue remains only partly covered.

options.title: Accept per-suffix semantics explicitly
options.body: Allow long streamed replies to invoke hooks per suffix only if maintainers reject the exactly-once guarantee and document that behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and continue this PR
recommendation.body: Fix suffix re-entry, keep the dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final coverage together, and use this as the canonical branch for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook and Telegram delivery history makes this the best available owner for the safety-hook boundary decision among the identified contributors.
